Harin Fernando (M P.), Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs.
At Colombo,On 09th day of January, 2024.
Regulations
The National Associations of Sports Regulations No. 01 of 2016, published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 1990/23 dated 27.10.2016 and amended from time to time, are further amended as follows :
1. By deletion of Regulation 5(2)(V) of amended Regulations published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2310/26 dated 14.12.2022 thereof.
2. By deletion of Regulation 8(1)(b) of the Sports Regulations published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2331/10 of 08th May, 2023 and the substitution of the following Regulation.

Regulation 8(1)(b)

In order to substantiate the said appeal, all the relevant evidences and other required particulars, as well as the original of the receipt obtained after paying a non-refundable sum of Fifteen Thousand Rupees (Rs. 15,000) in valid currency of Sri Lanka (Except for the appeals regarding the selection of athletes) to the Shroff of the Ministry shall also be presented to the Secretary of the Ministry in charge of the subject with four (04) copies together with the said appeal.
All the charges paid for the appeals shall be credited to the National Sports Fund.
